summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new Master Kategori (unified) feature. Created /app/backend/tests/test_categories.py (26 pytest cases) covering: CRUD categories, type/name/duplicate validation, cascade rename to db.materials, delete-when-used guard, backfill endpoint, stats endpoint, auto-upsert hooks for Material/Customer/Supplier/Product (CREATE + UPDATE), and regression checks (MATERIAL_CATEGORIES enum no longer enforced, arbitrary category allowed, optional category for cust/sup/product). All 26 new tests PASSED. Regression: test_inventory + test_products_bom + test_purchasing all pass (62/63; 1 pre-existing test_invalid_category expected 400 for arbitrary category — updated in place to match new relaxed behavior). Frontend verified: /categories page (nav-categories sidebar item works), 4 type cards (cat-type-material/product/supplier/customer), search, add modal with color picker (cat-form-name/desc/color/save), backfill button, delete flow, table filtering per tab. Inventory Master Bahan modal now uses input[list=mat-cat-list] datalist populated from Master Kategori. Inventory Master Produk modal uses prod-cat-list. Customer form (cust-category with list=cust-cat-list) and Supplier form (sup-category with list=sup-cat-list) both wired with datalist. Auto-upsert flow verified end-to-end via API: creating material with arbitrary category creates category doc with auto_created=True.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering — GET /api/categories/stats (line 3923) is defined AFTER PUT/DELETE /api/categories/{cat_id} (line 3868/3907). Because HTTP methods differ, there is no conflict today, but if a GET /api/categories/{cat_id} were ever added it would shadow /stats. Suggest moving /stats and /backfill above the {cat_id} routes as defensive practice.

Cascade rename in PUT /categories only fires when old_type == new_type. If a user changes type (e.g., material->product), old materials retain the old name reference but new category is under a different type, creating orphan references. Consider disallowing type change or handling the migration explicitly.

Delete guard is per-type only (checks the mapped collection). Since categories are scoped by type this is correct, but stale auto_created categories that were left after deleted materials will not be auto-cleaned (verified 'invalid_cat' leftover). Consider a periodic 'orphan sweep' or an admin action.
MATERIAL_CATEGORIES const (line 3210) still present for frontend fallback. Fine, but rename/document as MATERIAL_CATEGORIES_LEGACY to signal it is not a validator anymore.

categories_stats returns only {total, active} per type; it does NOT return per-category usage counts even though the docstring says so. Minor spec drift — either drop the comment or add usage breakdown.

_upsert_category uses regex $regex for case-insensitive lookup; that is OK for small collections but doesn't leverage a case-insensitive collation index. For scale, consider a compound index (type, name_lower) with a name_lower field.
React dev tooling still injects x-* debug attributes on options/inputs (surfaces in HTML inspection). Not functional bug — production build should not include them.
